findings.highlight: Tohsaka has hers on the opposite hand from mine, around the middle of her right hand or somewhere around there.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は俺とは逆で、右腕の真ん中あたりにあるとかないとか。
findings.governingReading: Shirou vaguely reports that Rin's mark is somewhere around the middle of her right arm, on the opposite side from his.
findings.explanation: Shirou's vague report changes from the middle of Rin's right arm to the middle of her right hand. This concerns his reported location, not proof of where her mark actually lies.

findings.highlight: As soon as magical energy run through my body, I begin my usual training.
findings.evidenceJa: 全身に魔力を通したら、あとはお決まりの“強化”の練習。
findings.governingReading: Mana runs through him; that is all he can do now.
findings.explanation: Two training lines lose agreement or their subject.
